newsitem.title: INDIA: Twenty-two killed in Indian truck-bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Twenty-two killed in Indian truck-bus crash.

text.p: At least 22 people were killed and six injured when a bus collided with a truck in the western state of Gujarat, the United News of India reported on Sunday.
The accident took place at Charodi, a village 200 km (125 miles) north of Bombay, the news agency said. It did not say when the collision took place.
The bus was travelling from Ahmedabad to Bombay.
